files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Meal delivery as a week: one column per day (its name and delivery note) with the meal of that day as a small
  card (picture, name, weight, price). Axes: media (image, none), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";
import type { DishSection } from "./restaurant-menu.types";

export type WeekMenuProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  dishes: Dish[];
  sections: DishSection[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: FoodLabels;
  media?: "image" | "none";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { fmtMoney } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  dishes,
  sections,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  media = "image",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<WeekMenuProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((sections?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="calendar" :title="empty" />
    <Box v-else class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5" data-testid="items">
      <Stack v-for="s in sections" :key="s.id" gap="2" class="border-t-2 border-primary pt-4" data-testid="day">
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {{ s.title }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ s.note }}
        </Text>
        <template v-for="d in dishes" :key="d.id">
          <Stack
            v-if="(d.tag === s.key)"
            gap="2"
            class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
            data-testid="item"
          >
            <MediaFrame v-if="((media as string) === 'image')" :alt="d.name" ratio="4/3" />
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ d.name }}
            </Text>
            <Group gap="2" align="baseline" justify="between">
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {{ d.weight }}
              </Text>
              <Inline class="text-sm font-bold">
                {{ fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency) }}
              </Inline>
            </Group>
          </Stack>
        </template>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
